user_input: Audit the session-refresh feature: locate its implementation and tests, list every violated team rule by id, and flag every mismatch with the documented session policy.
final_output:
# Audit

## Location
Implementation: code/src/auth/session.py (create_session, refresh_session); API route code/src/api/routes.py. Tests: code/tests/test_session.py only has test_refresh_extends_expiry (success path). SESSION_TTL_SECONDS = 3600. SESSION_SECRET is hard-coded. refresh_session(session, now=None) has no type hints. There is no maximum-lifetime check.

## Rule violations
Violated: SEC-03 (hard-coded SESSION_SECRET), STYLE-12 (refresh_session has no type hints), TEST-05 (no failure-path test for refresh_session / SessionExpired). REV-07 is a process rule, not checkable from code.

## Policy mismatches
docs/session-policy.md: idle timeout is 30 minutes (1800 seconds); a refresh extends by 30 minutes; maximum lifetime is 12 hours (43200 seconds).
